questions.question: How do input types improve UX and accessibility?
questions.answer: The type controls the mobile keyboard, browser picker, and built-in validation — email shows @, tel shows a dial pad, date shows a calendar. Using text for everything loses those benefits.

questions.question: When do you use checkbox versus radio?
questions.answer: Checkboxes are independent booleans and allow zero or more selections. Radios are mutually exclusive within a shared name, so exactly one can be selected per group.

questions.question: What is the difference between select, datalist, progress, and meter?
questions.answer: select restricts the user to listed options; datalist suggests options but still allows free text. progress shows task completion, while meter shows a measurement within a known range.

questions.question: Why must a button inside a form declare its type?
questions.answer: The default type is submit, so a Cancel button without type=button will submit the form. Always set submit, button, or reset explicitly.

questions.question: Build a radio group for experience level with a legend and a default selection.
questions.answer:
<fieldset>
  <legend>Experience</legend>
  <label><input type="radio" name="level" value="junior" /> Junior</label>
  <label><input type="radio" name="level" value="senior" checked /> Senior</label>
</fieldset>

questions.question: Create a country select grouped by region and a bio textarea.
questions.answer:
<label for="country">Country</label>
<select id="country" name="country">
  <optgroup label="Asia">
    <option value="in">India</option>
    <option value="jp">Japan</option>
  </optgroup>
  <optgroup label="Europe">
    <option value="de">Germany</option>
  </optgroup>
</select>

<label for="bio">Bio</label>
<textarea id="bio" name="bio" rows="4" maxlength="500"></textarea>

questions.question: Why is type=number a poor choice for phone numbers and PINs?
questions.answer: Number inputs strip leading zeros, may show scientific notation, and allow spinner changes. Use type=tel or text with inputmode=numeric to keep the exact digits.

questions.question: What is wrong with storing the user's role in a hidden input?
questions.answer: Hidden inputs are visible and editable in devtools, so users can tamper with them. Use them only for state, and always validate authorization on the server.
